examples.english: In this region, grains such as rice and wheat are produced as the main agricultural products.

notes:
{穀物|こくもつ} is a general term for cereal grains cultivated as staple foods. It is a somewhat formal or technical term; in everyday speech, specific grain names are more common.

EXAMPLES OF GRAINS:
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧: rice
- ⟦{小麦|こむぎ}→小麦：01407_komugi⟧: wheat
- ⟦{大麦|おおむぎ}→大麦：12215_oomugi⟧: barley
- ⟦とうもろこし→とうもろこし：10394_toumorokoshi⟧: corn

COMPOUNDS:
- {穀物|こくもつ}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: grain prices
- {穀物|こくもつ}⟦{自給|じきゅう}→自給：23675_jikyuu⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: grain self-sufficiency rate
- {穀物|こくもつ}⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧: grain warehouse/silo
- ⟦{五穀|ごこく}→五穀：noentry⟧: the five grains (traditional term for staple crops)

Note: ⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧ (soybeans) is technically a legume but is sometimes included under {穀物|こくもつ} in a broader sense.
